supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: Significant 2D lateral extension relative to the outer ocular margin visible in profile

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: Muzzle and chin regions exhibit significantly higher pixel intensity (lighter/greyer) compared to the dark (lower intensity) periocular and cheek regions

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: Thick lower lip with a distinct structural downward droop in a neutral state

pinna_silhouette.severe_cartilage_deformities: Deep V-shaped notch or missing cartilage segment in the upper posterior quadrant of the helix

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major structural notch or amputation in the upper posterior section of the visible pinna
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent patch of high-contrast white/grizzled hair localized to the chin
